answers.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million WHEN period='Q2' THEN -amount_million END) AS REAL) AS value FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D';

WITH q1 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million WHEN period='Q2' THEN -amount_million END) AS v FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D') SELECT (CAST((SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D' AND period='Q2') AS REAL) - (SELECT v FROM q1)) / (SELECT v FROM q1) * 100 AS value;
